rows.en: 07  Destroy Shin Dragon
<operator(30090,1)><speed(2)>I serve as captain of the <color(4)>Tower<ce()>. I am <color(4)>Hayato Jin<ce()>.
rows.notes: Two sentences to keep the Tower span before the name span.

rows.en: <operator(30090,1)><speed(2)>Capt. <color(4)>Hoshino<ce()>. I have heard about you and your people. I gather you want information on <color(5)>Berkt<ce()>, but...
rows.notes: kanchou -> Capt. (ship captain), although Ruri's rank is Lt. Cmdr. elsewhere.

rows.en: <operator(30090,1)><speed(2)>Right now we must move into the operation at once. First, let me explain the <book(48)>Shin Dragon<endbook()>.
<topic()><operator(30090,1)><speed(2)>The <book(48)>Shin Dragon<endbook()> is a weapon built by the developer of <book(47)>Getter Robo<endbook()>, Dr. <color(5)>Saotome<ce()><thumbnail(190)>.
<operator(30090,1)><speed(2)><color(5)>Saotome<ce()> vanished, and even now, 13 years after it was built, its true nature is still not known.
<operator(30090,1)><speed(2)>Apart from the fact that a vast amount of <book(51)>Getter Rays<endbook()> is stored up inside it, that is.

<operator(30090,1)><speed(2)>The <book(49)>Invaders<endbook()><thumbnail(159)> you saw... By nature they seek <book(51)>Getter Rays<endbook()> and come swarming to the <book(48)>Shin Dragon<endbook()>.
<operator(30090,1)><speed(2)>In other words, as long as the <book(48)>Shin Dragon<endbook()> is there, the <book(49)>Invaders<endbook()>' invasion of Earth will never stop.
<operator(30090,1)><speed(2)>The <book(49)>Invaders<endbook()> are a threat that will lead the world to ruin. The <book(48)>Shin Dragon<endbook()>, their breeding ground, has to be removed.
<operator(30090,1)><speed(2)>Moments ago, an abnormal energy reading was detected around the <book(48)>Shin Dragon<endbook()>. ...Something is about to happen.
rows.notes: Orchestrator: shortened opening clause to fit three lines; meaning unchanged.

rows.en: <operator(30090,1)><speed(2)>Our operation this time is to destroy the <book(48)>Shin Dragon<endbook()>. I ask for your cooperation.
<topic()><thumbdown()><operator(30090,1)><speed(2)>Let me also tell you a little about <color(5)>Berkt<ce()>.
<operator(30090,1)><speed(2)>He<thumbnail(191)> is a senior <book(38)>New Federation<endbook()> officer whose special duty is to investigate and capture the <book(48)>Shin Dragon<endbook()>.
<operator(30090,1)><speed(2)>His force is made up of <color(5)>mobile weapons<ce()> all its own, and we too have fought it a number of times by now.
<operator(30090,1)><speed(2)>But to be honest, what kind of person he is remains largely unknown.
<operator(30090,1)><speed(2)>...That you are people from another world is, frankly, not something easy to believe right away.
<operator(30090,1)><speed(2)>Still, if you mean to go after <color(5)>Berkt<ce()> to find a lead on that, we will cooperate. Our interests align.
<thumbdown()><operator(30030,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Hayato<ce()> is right. Let us cooperate with the operation here.
<topic()><operator(30090,1)><speed(2)>Also, <book(47)>Shin Getter<endbook()><thumbnail(192)> will take part in this operation.
<operator(30090,1)><speed(2)>The pilots are <color(4)>Go<ce()>, <color(4)>Kei<ce()> and <color(4)>Gai<ce()>, three in all. They are a handful, but please look after them.

uncertainties.issue: "Hoshino kanchou" -> "Capt. Hoshino" (ship's captain); scene 4003040 has Amuro call her "Lt. Cmdr. Hoshino" (shousa). Different source words, kept distinct. "anata-tachi no koto" -> "you and your people".
"kanbu" rendered "senior officer" (glossary role: "Officer of the New Federation"); "executive" also possible.
"Hayato-san" rendered bare "Hayato"; no project convention for -san found in the finished scenes.
book(47) wraps "Getter Robo" in slot 22 and "Shin Getter" here, as in the source (two different words under the same book id).
"kuse no aru renchuu" -> "a handful" (avoids the q of "quirky").

checked_decisions: Slot 0 title equals missions_019 "07  Destroy Shin Dragon".
Speakers: 30090 Hayato Jin (all but slot 36), 30030 Ruri Hoshino (slot 36).

Slot 20 ruling: "Capt. Hoshino" follows the orchestrator decision (ship captains are Captain); the source word is kanchou, so it does not conflict with "Lt. Cmdr." (shousa) in 4003040. "you and your people" for anata-tachi accepted.

Slot 31 ruling: "senior ... officer" for kanbu accepted; agrees with glossary role "Officer of the New Federation". "He" is sourced (kare) and Berkt is male in glossary.json. <thumbnail> directly after the pronoun as in the source.
Slot 36 ruling: dropping -san accepted; reviewed hangar scenes 4004393 and 4004453 also drop it, so this is the de facto project convention.
Slot 37 ruling: book(47) wrapping "Getter Robo" (slot 22) and "Shin Getter" (slot 37) mirrors the source; both spellings match unit_names_014 / encyclopedia.
Slot 38 ruling: "a handful" is a fair rendering of kuse no aru renchuu and avoids the q glyph.
Slot 22: <thumbnail> follows "Dr. Saotome" as in the source (after hakase). Slot 25: <thumbnail> follows Invaders.
Shin Dragon, Getter Rays, Invaders, Tower, Hayato Jin, Berkt, Saotome, Go/Kei/Gai match glossary / encyclopedia spellings.
remaining_uncertainties: Slot 38: "yoroshiku tanomu" rendered "please look after them"; could equally be "I am counting on you". Both fit, left.
Slot 29: "kyouryoku wo negaitai" -> "I ask for your cooperation" supplies "I"; Hayato is the only possible asker, left.
